items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I worked with Handel incidentally on piano when I was there. John Handel... I worked with him on piano because Joe Robinson was sick

ctx.x: Well the president is there now, it's still there.

And then Pierron gave it up and I think he went into his other little business or something and Paul Barberant took the band over. And I worked with Paul Barberant I'd say about two years or so, maybe more. But anyway I worked with Paul Barberant until I went right in the Army. That was in 41 in April. And then he was the last band that I worked with in New Orleans. And I went in the Army and stayed four years and a half and went home to see my people, my mother and father. And I came right, I said that three…
Well I think I've wrote kind of a horn in the years now. When did you change over the trumpet?
